top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children under 2 years old was observed watching television during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §744.3651)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The gas inspection available for review during the inspection expired on 05/13/2023.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §744.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver didn't have their file available during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §744.3501(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This was re-cited when the operation has not yet received a daycare fire inspection as required.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was pending 10 hours of annual training hours.    One out of four employees was pending 6 hours in business.
